csv_project_name: Consultant for Campus Dining Strategic Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (UNC-CH) is undertaking a comprehensive Campus Dining Strategic Plan to establish a long-term vision for dining facilities across one of the nation's premier public universities. The planning study will focus on evaluating how dining facilities can better support student life, residential growth, academic success, campus vitality, and the University's long-range physical development. The resulting plan should position Carolina's dining program to meet projected enrollment growth while enhancing the quality, accessibility, resilience, and overall campus experience.
